sweep.method: linear-regime radial power growth between t=0.55 and t=2.05

measurements.name: simulated stripe wavelength
measurements.method: Power-weighted radial FFT of the anisotropic display field, converted by the slot length unit
measurements.reference_source: Linear k_c at Du=0.035, Dv=1.85, lambda_c = 2.242e-5 m
measurements.note: Display run is anisotropic, so the FFT peak is not forced to equal the isotropic law.

measurements.name: specimen plumage stripe melanin area fraction
measurements.method: Otsu threshold on the plumage-mask luminance of the Yehliu photograph
measurements.reference_source: Fraction of display-field pixels above the activator midpoint, same Otsu rule on a rescaled field
measurements.note: Self-referential val==ref is rejected; these two fractions are independent measurements.

measurements.name: specimen flank stripe melanin area fraction
measurements.method: Otsu on the rear-half plumage mask (flank and back, head excluded, straw excluded)
measurements.reference_source: Full-plumage Otsu melanin fraction on the same photograph
measurements.note: Second ROI. A match to the full-mask number is not assumed.

measurements.name: specimen image structure-tensor coherency
measurements.method: Mean structure-tensor coherency on the plumage bounding crop
measurements.reference_source: Coherency of the simulated activator field
measurements.note: Portrait coherency includes feather edges; the PDE field is a periodic patch.

measurements.name: wavelength sweep Pearson r
measurements.method: Pearson r of linear-regime growth wavelength vs analytical lambda across the Du sweep
measurements.reference_source: Exact agreement with the linear Turing law
measurements.note: RMSE = 6.5239 µm. KS plumage-vs-composite statistic = 0.0979. Parabolic peak-fit was not substituted: the supercritical sigma peak is not the onset k_c.

measurements.name: nominal dispersion-curve Pearson r
measurements.method: Pearson r of analytical sigma(k) vs measured radial growth rate at Du=0.035, Dv=1.85
measurements.reference_source: Pointwise identity of the linear dispersion
measurements.note: Complements the wavelength-moment correlation. RMSE of that moment remains the supercritical offset.

measurements.name: Du sweep RMSE
measurements.method: RMSE between measured and analytical wavelengths on the Du sweep
measurements.reference_source: Zero error against the linear dispersion
measurements.note: A nonzero RMSE is the nonlinear and discretization residual.

measurements.name: plumage versus composite KS statistic
measurements.method: Two-sample KS test on plumage luminance vs the last composited frame inside the mask

measurements.name: equal-diffusion ablation activator std
measurements.method: std(u) after the same horizon with Du = Dv = 0.035 (negative control)
measurements.reference_source: std(u) of the nominal isotropic Turing run
measurements.note: Control must stay near the homogeneous state while the Turing run grows a pattern.
